## iSpotify 19.5.3

This release was prepared automatically after [PR #65](https://github.com/RubinLabs26/ISpotify/pull/65) passed the protected test suite and merged.

### Changes

- deps(deps): update yt-dlp requirement from >=2026.10.21 to >=2026.10.26

### Downloads

- Windows installer: `ISpotify-Setup-x86_64.exe`
- Windows portable: `ISpotify-windows-x86_64.exe`
- Linux portable: `ISpotify-linux-x86_64`
- Debian/Ubuntu: `ispotify_19.5.3_amd64.deb`

The release is published only after both platform builds succeed.
